{{Top|leg}}
'''Headquarters officer''' were [[staff officer]]s assigned to [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] and field commands. Headquarters officers assigned to garrisons held the rank of [[High Colonel/Legends|High Colonel]] and were responsible for the internal organization of the garrison, including security matters.<ref name="IG">{{JournalCite|12|Imperial Garrisons}}</ref>
